About Us

Solid work. Straight talk.
Built to last.

Essence Homes Construction Limited is a construction company based in Imo State, Nigeria, serving homeowners and businesses across the region and beyond. From the first block to the final coat, we hold every project to one simple standard: would we put our name on it?

Clients choose us for reliable delivery, quality workmanship and honest communication — a team that understands the build business in Africa and treats every project like our own home.

  • Experienced, safety-first site team
  • Transparent quotes — no hidden costs
  • Quality materials, built to stand the test of time
  • Clear communication from first call to handover

What We Do

Services built
around you.

From a single renovation to a full-scale build, every project gets the same discipline, the same materials standard, and the same respect for your budget.

Residential Building

Complete home builds from foundation to finishing — bungalows, duplexes and family homes constructed to specification, on budget.

Commercial Construction

Shops, offices, schools and mixed-use developments — solid structures delivered with professional planning and site management.

Renovation & Remodeling

We refresh, repair and reimagine existing spaces — roofing, plastering, tiling, plumbing and complete home makeovers.

Project Consultation

Expert guidance on cost, materials and feasibility before you build — so every naira decision is made with confidence.

Structural Design

Sound, buildable drawings and detailing that turn your vision into a structure engineered to stand the test of time.

How We Work

Four steps.
Zero surprises.

  1. 01

    Consult & Quote

    Tell us your vision. We assess the site and give you a clear, honest estimate — free of charge.

  2. 02

    Design & Plan

    Drawings, materials and schedule are locked in before a single block is laid.

  3. 03

    Build

    Skilled hands, quality materials and daily supervision — with progress updates throughout.

  4. 04

    Handover & Support

    We hand over clean and complete — and we're still a phone call away afterwards.
